capabilities: Move completed top-level tasks to a Done section
Add completion dates to swept tasks
Auto sweep after checking off a task
Restrict sweeping to selected files and folders
disambiguation: Does not delete completed tasks; it moves them to a ## Done section at the bottom of the note.
extras: Lightweight (~10 KB, ~900 lines of TypeScript, no dependencies, offline with no telemetry). Only [x] and [X] count as completed; other statuses and numbered tasks are left alone. Tasks already dated by another plugin such as Tasks get a second date. Sweeps pause on unclosed fenced code blocks, and undo/redo never trigger auto sweep. Works on desktop and mobile, Obsidian 1.4.0+. Not yet listed in the community catalog at time of writing. Made by Bryan Hogan, licensed 0BSD.
motivation: The author keeps to-do lists inside notes, but finished tasks pile up and get in the way; wanting to keep them visible while keeping open tasks on top, they built a tool to send finished ones to the bottom.
problem: Finished tasks pile up in in-note to-do lists and get in the way, but users don't want to delete them because it's useful to see what got done.
summary: Plugin that moves completed top-level tasks to a managed ## Done section at the bottom of the note, adding completion dates.
